subject: Stellarsys - MAP draft & pricing approval
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@stellarsys.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Stellarsys - MAP draft & next steps

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) based on our discovery: goals, milestones, and owners. High level recap:

- Primary use case: automated customer support triage and internal knowledge base search (support + docs).
- Success criteria: 40% reduction in average handling time and 90%+ answer accuracy on test prompts.
- Expected volume: ~1.2M tokens/month initially, scaling to ~3M in Q4.

Attached: MAP-draft-v1.docx (outline + milestone table). Please skim and let me know:
1) Any missing milestones or dependencies on your side (procurement, security, infra).
2) Who on your team will own each milestone (we've put placeholders).
3) Target close date — you mentioned end of April during the call; is 2026-04-30 still accurate?

Proposed next steps:
- You: review MAP and add owners/feedback by 2026-03-13.
- Me: incorporate feedback and loop in Pricing/RevOps for exec review (if discount/credits required).
- Schedule 30-min exec review if needed the week of 2026-03-16.

Quick note on pricing: list pricing is included in the MAP appendix. If you anticipate needing a committed discount or pilot credits, let me know now so I can engage internal approvers early.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an updated version after your notes.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.docx

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@stellarsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stellarsys - MAP draft & next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the draft — appreciated. A few quick notes after a skim and an internal sync with procurement:

- Procurement wants an explicit PO milestone and a procurement checklist added to the MAP (licenses, data residency, standard terms). I attached our procurement template for reference.
- For executive review, our CTO (john.cto@stellarsys.com) will want to confirm performance targets and integration plan.
- Regarding timelines: we can target 2026-04-30 for close, but procurement will need 2–3 weeks after legal signs off. Can you add a procurement review milestone with an owner?
- On pricing: we are evaluating multiple vendors. To get exec buy-in I’ll need visibility on any pilot credits and whether you can provide a short-term discount for an initial 6-month proof-of-value. Can you flag what is negotiable now vs. needs exec approval?

I’ll review the MAP in more detail and send inline comments by Friday.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Head of Product Operations | Stellarsys
elena.martinez@stellarsys.com

Attachment: Stellarsys_Procurement_Template.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Stellarsys - MAP draft & next steps (updated MAP + pricing notes)

Elena — thanks for the quick feedback and the procurement template. I’ve incorporated a procurement milestone and a proposed timeline below (also attached updated MAP-draft-v2.docx + PO template).

Summary of updated MAP (milestones, target dates, owners):
- Discovery complete & success criteria agreed — 2026-03-05 — (Stellarsys: Elena Martinez; Redwood: Marissa) [done]
- Draft MAP shared — 2026-03-10 — (Stellarsys: Elena Martinez; Redwood: Marissa) [done]
- Security & compliance Q&A (SOC2 evidence, data residency) — target 2026-03-19 — (Stellarsys: Security; Redwood: Solutions Eng)
- Pilot contract & PO submission — target 2026-04-02 — (Stellarsys: Procurement; Redwood: Marissa)
- Pilot kickoff (3 months) — target 2026-04-15 — (Stellarsys: Support Team; Redwood: Customer Success)
- Exec review & pricing approval — target 2026-03-18 — (Stellarsys: Elena + CTO; Redwood: Sales + RevOps)
- Closed/Won (full commit) — target 2026-04-30 — (Both)

Pricing (high level):
- List: Consumption-based + committed discount tiers (appendix for details).
- Current ask from customer in thread: pilot credits and a short-term discount for 6-month POV.

Action for internal team (Jonas / Marcus / Lauren): could you review the ask below and advise what we can provisionally offer vs. what needs exec approval?
- Pilot credits: customer requested a pilot credit line to offset integration effort (they did not specify an amount).
- Short-term discount: 6-month promotional rate to encourage adoption during pilot.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.docx, Stellarsys-PO-template.pdf

Thanks all — if Jonas/Marcus can reply with guidance by 2026-03-14 I’ll update the MAP and propose a 30-min exec alignment call for 2026-03-16 or 03-17.

Best,
Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-13T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stellarsys - MAP draft & pricing notes (pilot credits / discount)

Marissa / Marcus — quick internal take:

- Pilot credits: we can approve up to $12k in consumption credits for a 3-month pilot without exec escalation. Anything above that should go to VP/Sales Ops for approval.
- Short-term discount: we can offer a 15% promotional discount for the initial 6-month POV as a provisional offer, but anything more (or a multi-tier committed discount) will need RevOps/Finance sign-off.
- Need: estimated monthly run-rate during pilot (tokens/month) and expected uplift to size committed tier post-pilot. If Stellarsys can confirm numbers, we can sketch a two-tier commit that meets pricing constraints.

I can join the exec review on 2026-03-16 if that helps.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-14T11:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stellarsys - MAP draft & pricing notes

Marissa, Jonas —

Agree with Jonas. A few implementation notes from RevOps/Finance:
- If we extend the $12k credit and 15% promo, we should tie it to a mutually agreed pilot acceptance criteria and an explicit commit plan if the pilot meets goals (e.g., 6-12 month committed spend at tier X).
- Provide a PO milestone in MAP with a dependency on legal/terms; procurement timelines are realistic (2–3 weeks post-legal).
- I'll draft a provisional credit & promo term sheet we can attach to the MAP and share with Stellarsys during the exec call.

I'll have the draft term sheet ready by EOD 2026-03-15.

— Marcus
